ctx.x: And then something else happened to the show that hadn't happened since Russ Columbo, the matinee idol, you know. The raised the box office price to twice its normal, you know, amount, see.

Then someone else come, you see. This Harry Joe Brown, Junior, and some real estate men from up from Westchester. And they had this house down there where Orson Wells used to broadcast (unintelligible) theater." See, it was the largest seating capacity. And they wanted us to represent the show in their theater, you see. And -- oh, yeah, you know, from the Capezio shoe company, you know. They come back stage and he says, you know -- invited -- gave us an invitation
to all the show members to come to his store and get free shoes, dancing shoes, you know, and the taps, see. I have to-- laughter, you see.
